topPRs.title: Add NAPS token to Base

**Tests**
N/A - new token listing only
Contributions welcome! See https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md

topPRs.title: Add skUSD (Staked Kerne Synthetic Dollar) on Base
topPRs.author: enerzy17
topPRs.body:
Adds skUSD, the staked form of kUSD, a standard ERC-4626 vault native to Base (chain 8453).

- Native token, not bridged: `nobridge: true`, `tokens.base` only.
- On-chain metadata matches the contract: name "Staked Kerne Synthetic Dollar", symbol skUSD, 24 decimals.
- Address: 0x96F5102C15b839757f811A98CEc3725Ac21DfA14 (source-verified on BaseScan and Sourcify).
- Underlying asset is kUSD (0x5C2EfdF0D8D286959b42308966bc2B97f5680AA3).
- DefiLlama: https://defillama.com/protocol/kerne
- Logo: data/skUSD/logo.svg (SVG, 450x450).

Early stage; first external audit (Hexens) in progress, not yet complete. Admin keys not yet renounced.

topPRs.title: Add kUSD (Kerne Synthetic Dollar) on Base
topPRs.author: enerzy17
topPRs.body:
Adds kUSD, a native Base (chain 8453) yield-bearing synthetic dollar.

- Native token, not bridged: `nobridge: true`, `tokens.base` only.
- On-chain metadata matches the contract: name "Kerne Synthetic Dollar", symbol kUSD, 18 decimals.
- Address: 0x5C2EfdF0D8D286959b42308966bc2B97f5680AA3 (source-verified on BaseScan and Sourcify).
- DefiLlama: https://defillama.com/protocol/kerne
- Logo: data/kUSD/logo.svg (SVG, 450x450).

Backing is 1:1 USDC via a Peg Stability Module with an EIP-191 signed hourly proof of reserves; anyone can recompute it at https://kerne.fi/verify-anything . The protocol is early stage and its first external audit (Hexens) is in progress, not yet complete.

topPRs.title: Add NMR on Base Sepolia
topPRs.author: graemecode
topPRs.body:
## Summary
Adds Numeraire (NMR) to Base Sepolia through Base's listed `OptimismMintableERC20Factory`.

## Token pair
- Ethereum Sepolia: [`0xb434437a6554a7320cfabd194179b7b5cbd59b84`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0xb434437a6554a7320cfabd194179b7b5cbd59b84)
- Base Sepolia: [`0xc67B1795EE29EF012D23538ef1ab9C0D56c1E3f0`](https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xc67B1795EE29EF012D23538ef1ab9C0D56c1E3f0)
- Factory deployment: [transaction](https://sepolia.basescan.org/tx/0x034f40997f4ddc99e06fa30be9cdaed5b3089bf6f1602583f4d0fc94e8d49b58)
- Canonical 1 NMR bridge validation: [transaction](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x25a382dbcf6fb7f20eea48ede1bb2377a9ae2d6e29929df853bf07454eedeeb0)

The Base token reports the Ethereum Sepolia address as `remoteToken()` and Base's L2 Standard Bridge as `bridge()`.

## Validation
- `pnpm exec tsx ./bin/cli.ts validate --datadir ./data --tokens NMR`
- `pnpm typecheck`
